restaurantName: Zheng Zhi Wen Ji Pig's Organ Soup
address: Clementi 448 Food Centre, #01-26, 448 Clementi Ave 3, 120448, Singapore
bio: As well as pork offal, the menu features marinated pork trotter, kway chap and bak kut teh. But the noodle soup with pork liver and kidney stands out – the offal is cooked perfectly and the broth loaded with herbal aromas....
